label: Fires at GO after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial, stronger when observer favors S2.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is('a2 S2 u') * (ep_trial < 76) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is('a2 S2 u') * belief_lo
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial < 3) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * np.abs(belief_lo)
explanation: Activity occurs only at GO and almost only when the previous trial was a2 -> S2 common and unrewarded (residual +0.27 vs -0.03 for every other pattern). Within that case, magnitude grows as the ideal observer belief shifts toward S2 being good (negative weight on belief_lo), i.e. the unrewarded outcome conflicts with an S2-favoring belief. A single indicator gives dev R^2 0.43; adding the belief gating gives 0.50. Extra history terms (the trial before also a2, other patterns, early-episode) add almost nothing (free fit 0.505). Remaining misses are mostly on the window first trial where the previous trial is unknown. Timing (larger mid-episode) is in the baseline. No future variables used.

issues: The claims as stated hold up. On test, the indicator alone (phase==GO)*last_is('a2 S2 u') scores 0.433. Adding *belief_lo with a negative weight (-0.066) raises it to 0.500, and belief in place of belief_lo gives 0.494. Adding belief_cover, abs(belief_lo), the reward two trials back, or last_is('a1 S2 u') adds at most 0.002.

The analysis missed a large systematic class: the feature goes silent late in the episode. The timing baseline for GO falls to about 0 in episode deciles 8-9 (+0.0004, +0), so the feature does not fire even after a2 S2 u in the last ~25 trials. The additive baseline cannot express this, so the short form over-predicts late in the episode and under-predicts the a2 S2 u response earlier.

Gating the indicator by episode time fixes it. (phase==GO)*last_is('a2 S2 u')*(ep_trial < 76) ;; (phase==GO)*last_is('a2 S2 u')*belief_lo scores test 0.626 (dev 0.622), against 0.500 for the recorded form. That is above the reported free fit (0.507) and the 'additive ceiling' (0.54). A cutoff sweep gives 0.603 at 70, 0.624 at 74, 0.626 at 76, 0.621 at 78 and 0.610 at 80. A linear ep_dec interaction alone also adds +0.047 (0.548).

So the explanation's statement that further terms 'add almost nothing' and that remaining misses are mostly window-first trials is wrong. After the fix, the largest remaining under-prediction is GO after a2 S2 u, at only +0.016.
The label omits that the feature only fires before about trial 75 of the episode.
